source.file: isesaki/Route/東武伊勢崎線/35 快速.csv
source.soundPolicy: No sound files, sound references, train selection, arrival/departure clocks imported

semantics.s: metres relative to Asakusa Stop; absolute source distance=s+originAbsoluteM
semantics.curve: radius metres: negative left, positive right, 0 straight; cant millimetres, default unsigned
semantics.height: rail height above local ground, not rail elevation
semantics.rail: positive X right/Y up relative to player rail; omitted values retain last state; changes interpolate from preceding25m block only
semantics.form: one25m block; rail2 L/R means outside edge, numeric means platform between rails; roofIndex/formIndex select source object
semantics.limit: kmh=0 means restriction ends; post is sign side, direction is arrow/course, neither chooses rail
